name: Isometric icon
region: Desktop operating systems of the 1990s, then infographic and web illustration
summary: Icons drawn as small objects in a parallel isometric view: three faces at once, edges at 30° to the horizontal, no vanishing point. Flat colour fills give each face its own tone.

philosophy.core_thesis: An icon can show an object as a solid in space and keep it exact, because parallel projection keeps every edge at a true angle.
design_principles: Draw on an isometric grid with edges at 30° and 150° to the horizontal and vertical edges at 90°.
Show three faces: a top face in the light tone, a left face in the mid tone and a right face in the dark tone.
Use 3 tones of one hue for each object, 15–25% apart in lightness.
Keep all parallel edges parallel; no vanishing point and no foreshortening.
Fit the object into a hexagonal keyline that fills 80–90% of the grid.
Use a 1–1.5 px stroke at 48 px only when the faces need separation.

grid.keylines: A hexagon that holds an isometric cube of 56 px across, with its centre on the grid centre.

stroke.rule: An optional 1–1.5 px outline at 64 px, in the darkest tone of the object; the faces carry the form.

shape.primitives: Isometric boxes, cylinders and planes; edges at 30°, 90° and 150° only.
shape.optical_size: At 32 px, drop small parts and keep the three faces; at 128 px, add one level of detail such as a screen or a label.

colour.strategy: 3 tones for each hue, with 2 to 3 hues in one icon; the top face is the lightest.

perspective_and_light.light: A fixed light from the top; the light sets the tone of each face, not a gradient.
perspective_and_light.shadow: A flat parallelogram on the ground plane in a darker tone at 10–20% opacity, or none.

metaphor.typical: A server, a box, a laptop, a document stack, a building and a chart.
metaphor.treatment: Objects shown as small solids; a process is a group of solids on one ground plane.

emotion.target_response: Clarity with depth: the viewer sees a system as a small, ordered model.

avoid_when: The icon sits inline with text at 16–24 px.
The brief asks for a flat, front-view system.

modifiers.how: Keep the colours; turn the object to a front view and merge the three faces into one flat fill.
Keep the solid form; add gradients, a highlight and a soft cast shadow.

fill_mode.note: Each face takes one flat tone; the light sets the tone, not a gradient.

sources.title: toicon isometric icons on Wikimedia Commons
